mandatory_connectivity_constraints.rule: For each phase, lower MOS source, driver COM, VCC-cap negative, low-gate pulldown and HIN/LIN pulldowns connect to that phase SOURCE island ABOVE its shunt. Only shunt pad2 connects to GND/DC-. No same-net-name substitution or automatic GND thermal connection to SOURCE.

RS1/2/3 are actual two-terminal2512 parts. Take separate quiet sense routes directly from the resistor pad inner edges to the corresponding INA241 inputs, including a dedicated GND-side Kelvin trace. Do not sense through power copper or share sense routes with gate/source return.
Driver VS, bootstrap-negative and high-gate pulldown return to the corresponding PHASE/high-MOS source. Bootstrap positive is BOOT only. Neither return is GND.

U1 pad17/exposed pad and pin8 are EFUSE_RTN. Keep a separate small reference island for R2/R4/R5/R6/C2/SW1. U1 pin9 and input/output cap negatives are board GND. Thermal vias under U1 EP must be EFUSE_RTN or isolated, never global GND.

TO263 pad2/tab is drain. Q1/3/5 tabs and D1 tab are VBUS; Q2/4/6 tabs are separate U/V/W_PHASE; Q7 tab is BR_SW. Never combine their thermal copper or uninsulated conductive heatsink surfaces. Thermal vias must use each actual net.

Main commutation current path is C21/22 positive to upper MOS drain, PHASE to lower MOS drain, SOURCE through shunt to cap negative. Use broad paired bus copper; no inner-layer thin track, single small via, shared signal return or narrow thermal spokes for10A power flow.

Route HO with PHASE-return and LO with SOURCE-return as short pairs, keep gate resistors at MOS gate, and keep phase/drain pours from running under gate/input/sense traces. Use local SOURCE island for driver COM/VCC-cap return, not the global plane.

Keep U/V/W_PHASE, BR_SW, BB_L1/BB_L2 and BUCK_SW copper compact. Do not create broad board-wide inner planes for these nodes; keep them away from MCU/ADC/reference/Kelvin/control routes and mounting hardware.

For U2, wire inductor ends only to BB_L1/BB_L2, bootstrap caps to their matching switch nodes, VREG local only, VOUT_SENSE to output cap positive. For U3, SW area short to L2, bootstrap adjacent, FB sense after L2 at quiet output cap.

J5.1=VBUS and J5.2=BR_SW; external resistor goes between them. Q7 source return joins DC- power bus. Driver GND/control branch returns to Q7 source through a separate short branch, not the high-current drain/source path.

Maintain a quiet continuous GND reference for MCU, analog and digital signals outside local power/SOURCE islands. Join DC- power returns at shunt-low/bus-cap negative region; do not insert a deliberate split under returning logic signals or route power current through analog ground.

Suggested F.Cu components/power/gates, In1 mostly quiet GND outside local switch/SOURCE regions, In2 paired VBUS/GND copper and low-voltage rails, B.Cu signals/thermal distribution. All layers still obey actual nets and hot-node keepouts.

limitations: U6/R13 intentionally omitted: parent control placement puts the supervisor next to MCU.

Formerly empty footprint candidates are taken from pcb_footprint_candidates.json. mechanical_candidate means exact procured part/rating remains pending; actual library pad geometry is used for this placement.
L1/L2 10.4x10.4mm, F1 open6.3x32mm and connectors are mechanical candidates, not final procurement or current/thermal validation.

Only two main-bus2.2uF MLCCs exist for three bridge cells. This placement shares them between cells; switching-loop inductance, effective biased capacitance and overshoot require review before release. No third capacitor is silently added.
C19/C20 are25mm-tall radial capacitors; keep service/tool/heatsink clearance above them. C19/C20 origin is positive lead, not body center.
Power copper widths/thicknesses, via arrays, MOS/shunt/diode temperatures, heatsink, EMI, creepage/clearance and transient behavior have not been validated by this coordinate proposal.
No mains isolation claim: present design is low-voltage laboratory12..60V DC bus with12..24V auxiliary input. Future mains board requires a new safety/insulation review.

placement_check.method: Actual native footprint F.CrtYd line/rectangle/circle/arc bounds transformed using KiCad rotation convention. Conservative bbox comparison among these111refs only; parent must run complete-board collision/DRC checks.
